text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m interested in your lead generation requirement because it is specific, direct, and focused on qualified sales leads rather than broad marketing services.

I understand you are looking for leads for software development services, specifically from the Middle East, Canada, and the USA, and only from companies, individuals, or consultancies that are looking to work with a software development agency based in India. I also understand the lead stages you mentioned: cold, hot, and qualified. I’m comfortable working with structured data, organizing prospect lists, and helping qualify information clearly so you can review leads one by one and decide on the right fit.

While my background is centered on data work rather than digital marketing, I’ve spent years handling business information, cleaning datasets, and presenting insights in a clear, usable format. That means I can help keep lead records organized, accurate, and easy to evaluate. I pay close attention to detail, which is important when working with lead data across different regions and qualification stages.

One relevant project was a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, where I built a Power BI report on a star-schema model using SQL Server, Excel, and DAX. This replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one dashboard and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project reflects my ability to structure data well, consolidate information, and deliver something practical and efficient.

If you already have leads and want someone reliable to review, organize, and share them in a clean format, I’d be glad to help. I’m open to discussing your definition of a qualified lead on a web meeting so the process is clear from the start.

Regards,
Mina Castellan
